thread:
nina-recruiter: Omar is set to start 2026-05-18. He's on OPT and filed STEM OPT extension 5 weeks ago. He only has an I-797C receipt + combo I-94; no EAD yet. Omar asked whether we can complete I-9 remotely and set up equipment before EAD arrives. cc @jess-peopleops @lee-onboarding
jess-peopleops: Short: USCIS receipt + unexpired passport + I-94 often allow Section 1 & 2 completion as "receipt" for List A documentation but vendor (WorkBright) needs to be ok with remote verification. We should check with counsel and security for access provisioning.
lee-onboarding: Onboarding note: we normally do in-person I-9 within 3 days. For fully remote hires we use WorkBright + video verification. If we accept the receipt, we still require EAD when issued for final verification.
omar-newhire: I can do a live video with WorkBright. I uploaded receipt, passport, and I-94 here: https://drive.company/boxed/omar/imm. Want to make sure I can get laptop day 1.
imm-counsel: Legal: employer may accept the USCIS receipt as temporary List A evidence for Form I-9 per guidance for EAD renewals and STEM extensions, but document clearly: "Receipt presented; EAD pending; follow-up required upon issuance." Ensure follow-up tickler for 30 days. If final EAD denied, revoke privileges per policy.
security-ops: Access policy: we can provision standard developer VPN + laptop if I-9 is provisionally accepted; however we restrict privileged access (prod keys, admin consoles) until final work authorization is confirmed. Need onboarding ticket to include "pending EAD" flag.
jess-peopleops: OK I'll open a WorkBright case and schedule a live verification slot for Omar on 2026-05-17. We'll provision laptop and non-sensitive accounts day 1. Security to hold prod/admin access until EAD copy uploaded.
lee-onboarding: I'll create an equipment ticket and mark as "hold for full access". Omar, please upload EAD as soon as you get it and tag @jess-peopleops.
omar-newhire: Thanks everyone. If EAD is delayed past 30 days can we extend provisional access?
imm-counsel: We can extend with documented business justification but avoid elevated permissions. Notify security and people-ops for any extension beyond 30 days.
jess-peopleops: I've created WorkBright case #WB-7621 and scheduled the video check. Posting confirmation and the drive link in the case. Will update here after verification.
security-ops: Noted. We'll prepare role-based onboarding with hold on IAM groups: prod, payments, and deployment. Dev/staging access OK.
nina-recruiter: I'll message Omar to confirm the video time and remind him to have documents ready. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
omar-newhire: Got it — see you on 5/17. Appreciate the fast turnaround! :pray:
